card.name: Management and presenting-with in clinical advice
card.fires_on: The word "management" after appropriate, clinical or patient, and "present(s)" or "with" in "patients who present with". It appears in warnings and clinical guidance text.

modes.label: Management
modes.description: The word management after appropriate, clinical or patient, or in a table title.
modes.example: The early diagnosis of this condition is important for the appropriate<< management>> of these patients.

modes.label: Present with
modes.description: The verb present, or the word with after it, introducing a symptom such as diarrhea or pain.
modes.example: considered in all patients who present<< with>> diarrhea following antibiotic use. Careful medical
